docket_entries.description: AUTO ACCIDENT CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $7,500.00 FILED BY VARGUEZ, EVELIO AS TO DEFENDANT GONZALEZ, DANIEL ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR APR-21-2006 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506
SUBPOENA DUCES TECUM ISSUED TO VARGUEZ, EVELIO
SUBSTITUTED PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT GONZALEZ, DANIEL

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF VARGUEZ, EVELIO RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT GONZALEZ, DANIEL $1,811.00 PRINCIPAL, $105.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $1,916.00, THE COURT DETERMINES PLAINTIFF'S DAMAGES TO BE $5175 - THE VALUE OF PLAINTIFF'S CAR AT THE TIME OF THE LOSS. THE COURT DETERMINES DEFENDANT DANIEL GONZALEZ TO BE 35% RESPONSIBLE FOR PLAINTIFF'S LOSS. THE JUDGMENT IS A NET AWARD AGAINST DEFENDANT GONZALEZ. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
